title: Exploring the properties of the M31 halo globular cluster system

evidence.locator: Sect. 3.3 and Fig. 7: a broken power law fitted to the radial surface density of the clusters, with indices -0.80 +/- 0.10 inside about 5 kpc, -2.88 +/- 0.13 from about 5 to 30 kpc and -0.87 +/- 0.52 outside about 30 kpc. The last is replaced here by Mackey et al. (2019).
